nodes.name: constants.ts
nodes.summary: Defines shared frontend constants: the ROUTES map of all application URL paths (auth, dashboards per role, portfolio, settings) and the ROLES enum (STUDENT, COUNSELOR, MENTOR, ADMIN) plus a derived Role type.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses `as const` assertions to derive literal-typed route/role maps and a `keyof typeof` pattern to generate the Role union type from ROLES.
